content.text:
Submitted with the requested repair.

**Change made:** struck the capacity qualifier so the exception now reads "Except for Excluded Claims and **the payment obligations of Ono under this Agreement**, which are excluded from the damages subject to this cap...". Every payment obligation of Ono — licence fee, milestones and royalties under Article 6, supply/manufacturing prices, development cost reimbursements and indemnity payments — now sits outside the damages subject to the cap, so nothing in 16.7 conflicts with the retained Article 6 payment mechanics.

**Unchanged and re-verified:** single insertion of new Section 16.7 after p0733 (Article XVI runs 16.1–16.6; p0734 opens Article XVII, so numbering and placement are clean); mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable by Ono in the twelve months immediately preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000; Excluded Claims covering confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification under Article 10 and Sections 16.1/16.2, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement; Section 16.5 preserved verbatim and mapped as already meeting the mutual indirect/consequential exclusion. Validation returned ok:true with minimality clean, and all eleven preferred elements are mapped exactly once.

I also carried the two non-checklist points into the rationale for the deal team: "fees" is undefined against this deal's upfront/milestone/royalty structure, and the mutual cap concedes a limit on Array's currently unlimited direct exposure, so the USD 1,000,000 floor should be pressure-tested before tabling.
